caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular quilt design with a central area composed of a repeated geometric pattern of small squares, each square containing four red triangles forming an X-shape and a central white diamond, with accents of blue and yellow in some of the triangles. The central pattern is arranged in a grid, bordered by a wider frame. The border consists of large red shapes resembling four-petaled flowers or curved star motifs, each set inside white squares, with each motif surrounded by a fine black grid pattern. The main colors in the composition are red, white, blue, and yellow, with black lines used for outlining and creating the grid effects. There is also a scale diagram and some handwritten notations and measurements at the bottom left of the drawing.
title: Bedspread
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
